# SideSight
## For DeepSeek Harness
SideSight supports both of DeepSeek Harness's native extension paths: a filesystem skill for the sim
plest installation, and a configurable plugin bundle. Neither path starts an MCP server.
### Install as a configurable DSH plugin
In a DSH conversation, ask the agent:
> Please install ZhuXinAI/sidesight dsh plugin
Or directly run:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart the profile after changing its configuration:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Open DSH Web Settings and choose the `SideSight` entry to fill in the Base URL, Vision model, and AP
SH Web Settings and choose the `SideSight` entry to fill in the Base URL, Vision model, and API key.
> Important: after configuring SideSight, select a model from the **DeepSeek (SideSight vision)** pr
ovider before attaching or pasting an image. The regular `DeepSeek-V4-Flash` / `deepseek-official` r
oute is text-only and will reject the attachment before SideSight or any tool can run.
The API key field is write-only: an existing key is shown only as configured, never prefilled or ret
urned. You can also set the plugin fields in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The plugin contributes the configured values to DSH-managed shell calls and the skill maps them to S
ideSight's `SIDESIGHT_BASE_URL`, `SIDESIGHT_API_KEY`, and `SIDESIGHT_MODEL` variables when it invoke
s `npx -y sidesight <command>`. The API key value is not interpolated into the command text or ordin
ary tool result, and the skill forbids inspecting or printing it. Treat the profile configuration as
sensitive because a manually entered key is stored with that profile.
The pasted-image bridge uses the package's bundled `dist/cli.js` when available. A GitHub/source ins
tall does not contain that generated directory, so the plugin automatically falls back to `npx -y si
desight`; no separate manual CLI install in the DSH profile is required. The fallback needs `npx` an
d npm access or a cached SideSight package.
### Install as a filesystem skill
DeepSeek Harness natively discovers filesystem skills from `.dsh/skills/` in a project or `$DSH_HOME
/skills/` (normally `~/.dsh/skills/`) for all projects. No adapter or core workflow change is requir
ills/` (normally `~/.dsh/skills/`) for all projects. No adapter or core workflow change is required.
Install for the current project from its Git repository root:

Or install for all DSH projects:

The repository-level `SKILL.md` routes visual work directly to `npx -y sidesight image`, `ui`, `ocr`
, `diagnose`, `diagram`, `chart`, `diff`, or `video`.
### Enable attached-image vision in DSH
DSH checks the selected model's declared input modalities before it accepts an attached image. The o
riginal `deepseek-official` text route will therefore show “the current model does not support image
s” even when SideSight credentials are configured. After filling the SideSight Settings fields, choo
se a model from the added `DeepSeek (SideSight vision)` provider, for example `DeepSeek-V4-Flash (Si
deSight vision)`. The wrapper advertises image input to DSH, reads the durable attachment through DS
H, sends it to SideSight, and forwards only bounded visual evidence to the original text model; the
native thumbnail remains in the session log.
The attached-image bridge handles the exact durable attachment automatically. The SideSight skill do
es not ask the model to locate an attachment on disk or create a local copy. Native DSH image toolin
g remains available for an explicitly supplied local path, but it is not an attachment-recovery step
. Keeping the original text route selected is expected to preserve DSH's image rejection; switch to
the SideSight vision variant for attached images.
The attachment bridge uses the exact DSH attachment bytes in a private operating-system temporary di
rectory and removes that temporary materialization after analysis. It does not silently replace an a
ttachment with `clipboard`, `latest`, or an older workspace file, and it does not create a workspace
copy. For a direct CLI call on an existing path outside the workspace, pass that file's containing
directory as a scoped allowlist:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
For DSH plugin users, `npx sidesight setup` is optional. You do not need it when `baseUrl`, `apiKey`
, and `model` are filled in through DSH. It remains available as a fallback when those fields are bl
ank, and for filesystem-skill installations that prefer SideSight's owner-only saved configuration.
To install into another profile, replace `web` with that profile name. Remove the bundle with `dsh p
lugin --profile <name> remove sidesight`.
## What SideSight does
SideSight gives a text-only coding model a safe, scriptable way to ask a separately configured multi
modal model about screenshots, diagrams, charts, UI differences, and videos. For explicit OCR reques
ts on macOS, it can use Apple Vision locally instead. The host agent receives concise text and struc
tured evidence; it never needs native image support.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Security and privacy
Media is untrusted input. Local paths are canonicalized against an allowlist, symlink escapes are re
jected, file size and image dimensions are bounded, and MIME type is checked against magic bytes. Re
mote URLs are limited to HTTP/HTTPS, resolved and checked against private, localhost, and cloud-meta
data networks, downloaded with timeouts and response-size limits, and revalidated across redirects.
URLs embedded in media are returned only as evidence; they are never fetched.
Cloud-backed images and videos are transmitted to the configured vision provider. Use a local or pri
vate OpenAI-compatible provider for sensitive screenshots, or use explicit `--provider local` for ma
cOS OCR. API keys, authorization headers, data URIs, and full provider payloads are redacted from no
rmal diagnostics. Vision output is untrusted evidence; SideSight never executes commands or modifies
ision output is untrusted evidence; SideSight never executes commands or modifies files based on it.
